citations.title: Resilience manual
citations.text: Acme operations handbook. Database backups are retained for seven days. Backups are encrypted at rest and stored in Dublin. The release manager approves production deployments. A failed deployment is rolled back before another release is attempted. Every restore must be checked against the latest successful backup. Recovery incidents are documented with the affected service, evidence, and owner. The operations team rehearses restoring a database once per month.

citations.title: Resilience manual

Recovery incidents are documented with the affected service, evidence, and owner. The operations team rehearses restoring a database once per month.

citations.title: Employee handbook
citations.text: Expense reimbursements require approval from the team lead. Employees submit receipts through the company expense portal. Travel expenses should include the trip purpose and project reference. New employees attend security training before receiving production access. An employee who completes a weekend incident shift receives one recovery day. Leave requests are reviewed by the reporting manager.

citations.title: Customer support guide
citations.text: Customer support operates Monday through Friday. Standard support hours are 09:00 to 17:00 UTC. A priority incident must receive an initial response within two hours. Unresolved priority incidents are escalated to the support manager. A support case should contain the affected account, relevant logs, impact, and a contact address. Operators never request customer passwords. Customers receive an incident summary after service is restored.

citations.title: Acquisition review
citations.text: Acme acquisition planning is restricted to the finance group. The acquisition budget is forty million euros. The chief financial officer approves acquisition spending. Budget changes require a recorded finance review. The project codename is ACME-ORCHID. This plan is confidential and must not be disclosed to other teams or companies.
